newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP seeks to change law on company share buybacks.
newsitem.headline: LDP seeks to change law on company share buybacks.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) is seeking a change in the business law which would shorten the time needed to approve corporate share buybacks, an LDP subcommittee chairman said on Thursday.
The subcommittee will also seek the introduction of stock options, he told reporters.
"These system changes are to improve the market's infrastructure, which would have a good impact on the stock market in the medium and long term," the chairman said.
Under the current law, companies have to have their stock repurchases approved by the annual shareholders' meeting.
The proposal is to allow approval by the board of directors, which meets more often, the chairman said.
